reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT account_id,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
)
SELECT account_id, SUM(new_session) AS sessions
FROM flagged
GROUP BY account_id
alternatives:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
)
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes') AS sessions
FROM gaps
GROUP BY account_id

SELECT e.account_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM app_events e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM app_events p
  WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
    AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_id < e.event_id))
    AND p.event_ts >= e.event_ts - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
)
GROUP BY e.account_id

other_way.sql:
SELECT e.account_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM app_events e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM app_events p
  WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
    AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_id < e.event_id))
    AND p.event_ts >= e.event_ts - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
)
GROUP BY e.account_id
other_way.tradeoff: Counting events with no earlier event of the user in the 30 minutes before works without a window, but it is far slower on big tables.

solver.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts, event_name, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM app_events WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)),
s AS (SELECT *, SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS sn FROM f),
ss AS (SELECT user_id, account_id, sn, MIN(event_ts) AS st, MAX(event_ts) AS en, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY user_id, account_id, sn) SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM ss GROUP BY account_id
